ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Visible surface exhibits an approximate 55:45 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central axis and proximal regions are dominated by a contiguous dark-pigmented anchor-shaped blob. Lateral lobes are predominantly light-pigmented with significant clusters of dark mottling localized on the distal tips and upper trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate aperture of 62 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:4 relative to the inner lobe curvature.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing boundary; peak-to-trough amplitude is most pronounced on the distal thirds of both lobes, featuring jagged, saw-tooth pixel transitions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe edges follow a convex-upward curve originating from the median notch and sweeping towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated on the dark central peduncle area; smaller dark punctate spots distributed across the white ventral lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of roughly parallel, vertical high-contrast linear marks (rake-like abrasions) located on the right-side interface between the dark central pigment and the right white lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white irregular patch at the base of the visible peduncle; asymmetric edge erosion on the far left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Characteristic T-shaped or cross-shaped white pigment mark centered within the dark region just proximal to the median notch.
